scripts.build: npm run build -w @hall/contracts && npm run build -w @hall/api-contract && npm run build -w @hall/domain && npm run build -w @hall/mcp && npm run build -w @hall/templating && npm run build -w @hall/postgres && npm run build -w @hall/server && npm run build -w @hall/client && npm run build -w @hall/desktop
scripts.test:postgres: npm run build -w @hall/contracts && npm run build -w @hall/api-contract && npm run build -w @hall/domain && npm run build -w @hall/mcp && npm run build -w @hall/templating && npm run build -w @hall/postgres && node tests/postgres/run.mjs --pgtap all && vitest run --config tests/postgres/vitest.adapter.config.ts && vitest run --config tests/postgres/vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:backend: npm run test:coverage -w @hall/server && npm run test:coverage -w @hall/domain
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @hall/contracts && npm run build -w @hall/api-contract && npm run build -w @hall/domain && npm run build -w @hall/mcp && npm run build -w @hall/templating && concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,cyan "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build -w @hall/contracts && npm run build -w @hall/api-contract && npm run build -w @hall/domain && npm run build -w @hall/mcp && npm run build -w @hall/templating && npm run build -w @hall/postgres && npm run build -w @hall/server && concurrently -k -n client,desktop -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @hall/client" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5174 && cross-env HALL_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5174 npm run start -w @hall/desktop"
scripts.desktop:package: npm run build && npm run package -w @hall/desktop
scripts.desktop:make: npm run build && npm run make -w @hall/desktop
scripts.test:architecture: vitest run tests/meta/check-search-architecture.test.mjs tests/meta/exhaustive-dispatch.test.mjs tests/meta/postgres-single-access.test.mjs && npm run typecheck -w @hall/domain
scripts.lint: biome check packages/*/src packages/*/*.ts packages/client/e2e packages/client/tests scripts tests/meta tests/postgres tests/distribution
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write packages/*/src packages/*/*.ts packages/client/e2e packages/client/tests scripts tests/meta tests/postgres tests/distribution
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @hall/contracts && npm run build -w @hall/api-contract && npm run build -w @hall/domain && npm run build -w @hall/mcp && npm run build -w @hall/templating && npm run typecheck -w @hall/postgres && npm run typecheck -w @hall/server && npm run typecheck -w @hall/client && npm run build -w @hall/server && npm run typecheck -w @hall/desktop
scripts.quality: npm run check:architecture && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.quality:e2e: npm run quality && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:distribution: npm run pack:distribution && npm run test:distribution:artifact
scripts.check:distribution: npm run check:requirements && npm run check:architecture && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && vitest run tests/meta/distribution-documentation.test.mjs
